requests.ask: O2.md interim ruling 1 sets a success in ink on #3FBF7F. The darkest ink (#000) reaches only Lc 58.2 there, under the Lc 60 a bold word below 36 points needs, so no ink word on that fill passes under 36 points. P0-K1-tokens-2's plan to move the screens' smaller status words onto the green fill will fail the same contrast check. Please choose: success words at 36 points or more on the fill, a darker success fill, or paper on a darker green.
requests.default: Success words in words are set at 36 points on the #3FBF7F fill, as on the board; smaller success words keep their icon and use the alarm-like chip only once the fill is darkened by K1.
